title: SQLite opened as ":memory:" — nothing persists, and each pooled connection gets its own empty DB without the books table
evidence: main.go:41 sql.Open("sqlite", ":memory:"); schema created once at main.go:55 on one pooled connection; no SetMaxOpenConns/cache=shared anywhere (grep). Second-opinion probe (temp copy, 50 concurrent GET /books via booksHandler, 3 runs): map[200:1 500:49], map[200:4 500:46], map[200:2 500:48]. All data lost on restart.
suggestion: Open a file DB (e.g. sql.Open("sqlite", "books.db")), or at minimum db.SetMaxOpenConns(1) / file::memory:?cache=shared

title: Tests call handlers directly, never through the router or concurrently, so the per-connection :memory: bug is invisible
evidence: main_test.go:39-324 call createBookHandler/listBooksHandler/getBookHandler etc. directly; booksHandler and http.ServeMux are never exercised; no parallel requests
suggestion: Add an httptest.NewServer test over the real mux, including concurrent requests

title: Create also requires year and isbn, stricter than spec (only title and author required)
